summary: Count rows, browse Ravelry collections, and read your synced patterns offline.
page_description: Count rows for each section of a project, browse your Ravelry library, and read patterns you own offline.
release_notes: A project started from a pattern now opens on the pattern's first section. The Ravelry tabs and the project list read more plainly.

steps.text: Set up the reader once over USB, if you have not already. PDF patterns also need Poppler on this computer, which kobo needles setup installs.
Send a pattern you own. Each push adds a pattern; the ones already there stay.
Optional: Ravelry library sync needs an approved Ravelry API account. Install its credential under the name ravelry.
